how: Direct streaming POST to api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions from the app tab (a plain fetch, NOT a wrapper around the app's fetch — hazard 8). SSE lines split and parsed exactly as readOpenAICompatibleStream does, counting how many chunks carry a non-null choices[0].finish_reason.
conclusion: The field really does arrive on the streaming path, exactly once per response, and it distinguishes the two cases. Phase 0 recorded this as an inference from reading the code; it is now measured.
notMeasured: The Anthropic message_delta stop_reason. No Anthropic connection is configured, so that branch is implemented and unit-tested against the documented event shape but never observed on a live stream.
